relayChainIndex.derivation: lookup-only aggregation of candidate path relay numbers and relayChainUnion instance/state pairs; an unlisted sibling instance is resolved by its mechanical K<number>_ prefix only when that number is corroborated both by the relay table and by the same record's own resource list; otherwise it is listed as unresolved rather than inferred

consistencyNotes: The source relay table carries one representative instance name per relay number (e.g. K22_ACDRV1_F_S1), while candidate path relay chains also reference the sibling sense-side instance of the same number (e.g. K22_ACDRV1_S_S1). The number prefix is the shared identity.
Relay states observed inside candidate path chains are chain-context states, not a global relay schedule: state ON or NC in an entry describes that chain only.
No cross-site (_S1S2) relay arbitration for simultaneous multi-site execution was modelled in the source IR and none is asserted here.
